notes.title: Patch : 0.5.2.2
notes.content:
[NEW CONTENT]:

- New interface in the arcade terminals

- Teleporter:

    "A lot of people asked us for this feature, here it is: items can now cross teleporters!

    We also took the opportunity to make some changes related to balancing"

    - Items can pass through teleporters!
    - Each teleporter now has its own teleport speed.
    - Each player has their own teleport particle depending on their color (red, blue, purple, green)
    

[TWEAKS]:
- Input:
    - the taking into account of keyboard inputs has been improved in the menus.
    - Only the first controller connected and the keyboard now have control in the menus.

- Loading time at game launch has been reduced
- Support for teleporters by the pathfinding system (for the moment only concerns the Homing Missile)

[FIXED]:

- in the tutorial terminal, the video of the boomerang had been forgotten, so we added it
- fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when pressing pause after a player died

notes.title: Patch Note : 0.5.0 : New environment new item !
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42022884/b23ae7773a61096446794bb9c08fd6316f0a8308.png[/img]


We added "Street 2020" in the gameroom.

A new environment that will take you into the city of the future!
Challenge your friends now!

We have also added a new item the boomerang!

The boomerang will allow you to remotely steal an opponent's item in use or in their inventory!
It will also allow you to retrieve an item remotely in an item box!


Most of the known bugs have been fixed in the latest updates.
We now spend most of our time working on to implement new gameplay features.
Some of them couldn't be added in this patch but will be coming very soon ...


NEW CONTENT:
new item: Boomerang
- Boomerang can steal items owned by other players
- Boomerang can steal items with duration currently used by other players (except invincibility)
- Boomerang can steal projectile item already used by other player
- Boomerang can steal items from item Box
- if you miss your target, Boomerang come back to it's owner after (X)seconds -> currently .
- after stealing an item, the boomerang returns to its owner, once there, the player takes the stolen item
- colliding with a wall destroy the boomerang

new map: Street 2020

TWEAKS:
-

FIXES:
Fixed bug that issued player to path trough collider when using grapnel
Fixed a bug that issued player to lose focus of the pause and settings menu when using alt + tab
Fixed a bug that issued player to be stuck in the settings menu when navigating in the sound and video submenu
Fixed a bug that issued the gamepad cancel button to not work sometimes
Fixed a bug that issued player to invite friend when closing the friend list menu in the arcade room
Fixed a bug when playing solo with a keyboard and no gamepad device where keyboard device was duplicated in the character selection screen

UPCOMING CONTENT:
new map: Freeky Mansion
Tutorial mode
Teleport rework
